pos.personaBrief: Fortaleza 2018 led Serie B in possession and passes (Trivela, O POVO) and Ceni promised a Flamengo that likes possession; he also said he would use the counter only when feeling inferior.

pro.personaBrief: He wanted better build-up from the defence (Correio, Flamengo 3-4-2-1) and ball-keeping football, though with 'jogar em funcao do gol' and fast pressing recoveries.

est.personaBrief: Four mobile forwards, Isla/Arao/Filipe Luis alternating roles and Gabigol/Bruno Henrique combining through the middle point to fluid, relational play, though with defined shapes.

lar.personaBrief: Fortaleza used four forwards and Flamengo had Isla and Bruno Henrique opening as wide outlets, but forwards also combined through the middle.

blo.personaBrief: Flamengo under Ceni pressed the opponent's build-up and won balls high (Goal), 'marca a frente' was his stated style, with a four-man line without the ball.

mar.personaBrief: No source on marking; only 'marcacao encaixada' and high marking, with defensive errors seen as system errors, so a mixed zonal lean with tight pressing.

pla.personaBrief: He said 'nao mudo meu estilo de jogo' and was offensive by default, shaping systems around available players (three defenders if he had three good ones), while admitting counter-attack when inferior.

res.personaBrief: Stated aim was a proactive, goal-driven team with beautiful short-pass football (Babagol, DOL), though Flamengo 2021 added defensive caution.

sis.personaBrief: A system-minded coach who said defensive errors come from the system, demanded effort from all (compared to Simeone) and built mobile forwards who had to defend.

jog.personaBrief: Preferred technical short-touch football with intensity; backed Diego (36) as the 10 and wanted quality exits from defence, but with pressing demands.

bas.personaBrief: Asked for the return of loanee Muniz and used youngsters, but relied on veterans like Diego, Filipe Luis and Arao in the title run.

lid.personaBrief: Claimed 'eu nao mando em nada', sought Zico's blessing and built bonds at Fortaleza, yet was a demanding 24-hour coach with a controlling reputation.
